column1: # Hades (Supergiant Games' engine on The Forge renderer, SDK 9.3.0), update v589824 = 1.0.38233.
# Renders with Vulkan, not NVN: main imports 100 vk* functions, which subsdk0 (the Vulkan loader) supplies on top of subsdk1 (NVIDIA's driver: NVN, OpenGL, Vulkan).
# The host implements those functions on Metal itself, so only main and sdk are loaded. The shaders are SPIR-V files in Content/EffectsForgeSwitch (.vert / .frag;
# the .shader files list each program's pair). main's EOS_* imports (Epic Online Services, from /nro/EOSSDK-Switch-Shipping.nro, loaded through nn::ro) stay offline.
# Values marked "Mario's" are not measured for this game yet
# the right stick aims the cast
# its output size stub (patches.py) renders any size, and at a wider one the game uses its own ultrawide layout (the PC version's): the 16:9 view and HUD in the middle, its side
# bar art (Launch/SideBars_01, sgg's CalculateViewportForAspectRatio at main+0x47c1b0) on both sides, so the picture fills the screen with no black bars, crop or stretch (checked on the
# Mac at 2868x1320 and 1568x720). On an iPhone the output takes the screen's aspect (loader.c output_aspect; the launcher's Picture switch, Wide by default)
# main imports Vulkan, not NVN: the host's Vulkan layer (dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m); dm/gfx/tools/vk_shaders.py translates the SPIR-V shaders into <shader dir>/vk/
# subsdk0 / subsdk1 (Vulkan loader, NVIDIA driver) are replaced by the host's Vulkan layer and not loaded
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. Link's Awakening's partition until measured

column2: Hades has no NVN shaders (its SPIR-V shaders go through the Vulkan layer)
